test_title: PYST 8: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No improvement required’.

We __set up__ on the journey early in the morning.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase** "set off"** means to begin a journey.
 
• Other options do not convey the correct meaning of starting a journey.

**Correct Sentence:** *"We set off on the journey early in the morning."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "set about" - This phrase means to start doing something, but it is more commonly used with tasks or activities, not journeys.
 
• **Option 4:** "set in" - This phrase means to begin and become established, often used with weather or conditions, not starting a journey.
